byte_evidence.method: Parse attributable input_text JSON; count UTF-8 bytes of decoded exec_command.output only. Exclude protocol wrappers, bootstrap, edits and test results. Captured inputs reviewed as data, never executed.

notes: Four wrappers contain five actual nested shell calls. Ordinary treatment conforms: no aide calls or tool discovery, despite aide names appearing in test data.

All commands start rtk and source/edit/test commands set assigned-root workdir. Only permitted replacement.ts edited; no scratch file created. Inline checks import the in-root module and do not request outside source. RTK.md is the sole external bootstrap read. No prohibited retrieval, references, graders, other-trial results, global/index search, internet or delegation observed.
Visible and inline checks both pass. No failures or retries. Provenance integrity passes with reproducer unchanged. Scope refers to source/edit/work-product boundaries, not complete syscall tracing.
Retrieval bytes are returned text, not model tokens or causal savings. Functional grades are separate and unchanged.

host_event_count_crosscheck.note: Count comparison is boundary evidence only, not one-to-one byte/source proof or unchanged model delivery. Local discovery expressions do not produce nested tool-call receipts. t10/t16 wrapper truncation remains distinct from full host payload counts.
